pm5mmw.q: In the situation shown in the figure, the tram has priority over the other vehicles
pm5mmw.why: A tram has priority over all other vehicles at an intersection, regardless of where they are.

1nk6913.q: At the intersection shown in the figure, all vehicles must use caution when crossing it
1nk6913.why: Even the vehicle with priority must cross the intersection carefully, because having priority does not remove the duty of caution.

5pl1lz.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle O must wait for the tram to pass and for vehicle A to move to the centre
5pl1lz.why: Vehicle O must yield to the tram and to A, which comes from its right; A, turning left, moves to the centre of the intersection before O.

1loq7dp.q: In the situation shown in the figure, the tram goes first
1loq7dp.why: The tram has absolute priority over all vehicles, so it goes first.

j6uyir.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle M must wait for vehicle O to pass
j6uyir.why: O comes from M's right, so M must yield to it and wait for it to pass.

99t02a.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle M crosses the intersection together with the tram
99t02a.why: M must yield to the tram and to O, which comes from its right, so it cannot cross together with the tram.

wb3bv7.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle A, when turning left, has a clear right side
wb3bv7.why: When turning left, A must yield to the tram and to M, which travel in the opposite direction, and to O, which crosses its path, so its way is not clear.

1nuyb0t.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle O must wait for the tram and vehicle M to pass
1nuyb0t.why: O must wait for the tram and for A, which comes from its right, but not for M: M is on its left and must yield to O.

6z14vr.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle O must wait until all the other vehicles have passed
6z14vr.why: O must yield only to the tram and to A; M comes from O's left and must itself wait for O.

1mlcewc.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle A must give way to the tram, but not to vehicle M
1mlcewc.why: When turning left, A must yield not only to the tram but also to M, which travels in the opposite direction and crosses its path.

t4bi7m.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle O must give way to the tram and to vehicle M
t4bi7m.why: O yields to the tram and to A, not to M: M comes from its left and must yield to O.

cur6mx.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle B does not have to give way to the other two vehicles
cur6mx.why: B has no vehicle on its right, so it does not have to yield to either H or C.

g5723m.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle H goes second
g5723m.why: H yields only to B, which comes from its right, while C, which has H on its right, must wait: H goes second.

m9t165.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle C must clear the intersection last
m9t165.why: C has H on its right and must yield to it; H in turn yields to B. So C clears the intersection last.

op5zj8.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle B goes first
op5zj8.why: B has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first.

v1a4hp.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle C must give way to vehicle H
v1a4hp.why: H comes from C's right, so C must yield to it.

3z7lu.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle H goes first
3z7lu.why: H has B on its right and must yield to it, so H goes after B, not first.

1wm5j7d.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicles B and C go first, at the same time
1wm5j7d.why: C must yield to H, which in turn yields to B. The order is B, H, C, so B and C do not go together.

1sp8v2h.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle H must enter the intersection after vehicles B and C have passed
1sp8v2h.why: H only has to wait for B, which comes from its right; C has H on its right and goes after it.

8r04ve.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle H has priority over vehicle C because it is a bus
8r04ve.why: H goes before C because it is on C's right, not because it is a bus: the type of vehicle gives no priority.

a39utr.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle C goes first
a39utr.why: C must yield to H, which comes from its right. The correct order is B, H, C.

1vfqm82.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle R goes first
1vfqm82.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first.

145cgbd.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle C must go last
145cgbd.why: C has A on its right and must yield to it; A in turn yields to R. So C goes last.

12l7afw.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A must go after vehicle R
12l7afw.why: R comes from A's right, so A must yield to it.

16plkyh.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A goes before vehicle C
16plkyh.why: C has A on its right, so A goes before C.

10uvjvu.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle C must go after vehicles R and A
10uvjvu.why: C must yield to A, which comes from its right, and A yields to R. The order is R, A, C.

564mkz.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A, if it is a police vehicle with its warning devices in operation, goes first
564mkz.why: Police vehicles with their sirens and lights in operation have priority over all other vehicles.

1xrm9bb.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A goes first
1xrm9bb.why: A has R on its right and must yield to it, so A goes second, not first.

17hody7.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A must go last
17hody7.why: A yields only to R, while C must yield to A. So A goes second, not last.

xjvvva.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle R must go after vehicle A
xjvvva.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first, before A.

471caf.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle R must cross the intersection second
471caf.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first, not second.

1o9rbhl.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle C goes second
1o9rbhl.why: C has A on its right and must wait for it, so it goes last, that is, third.

o464o7.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicles C and R go first, at the same time
o464o7.why: The order is R, A, C: C must wait for A, which in turn yields to R, so C and R do not go together.

1aq4arn.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle L crosses the intersection first
1aq4arn.why: L has no vehicle on its right, so it crosses first.

19a96kw.q: In the situation shown in the figure, vehicle H crosses the intersection last
19a96kw.why: H has C on its right, and C in turn must yield to L, so H goes last.

lnhgm2.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle L, vehicle C, vehicle H
lnhgm2.why: L goes first, then C, which has L on its right, and finally H, which has C on its right. The order is L, C, H.

xgml8e.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle C after vehicle L, but before vehicle H
xgml8e.why: C goes after L, which is on its right, and before H, which must yield to it.

2j7a44.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle L at the same time as vehicle C, then vehicle H
2j7a44.why: C has L on its right and must yield to it, so they do not go together: first L, then C, then H.

18aeicf.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle H, vehicle C, vehicle L
18aeicf.why: L goes first and H last. The order H, C, L is the opposite of the correct one, which is L, C, H.

1u78ir.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle H, vehicle L, vehicle C
1u78ir.why: H has C on its right and cannot go first. The correct order is L, C, H.

11lx33f.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle L, vehicle H, vehicle C
11lx33f.why: H has C on its right and must yield to it, so C goes before H, in the order L, C, H.

yudtcr.q: It is permitted to cross the intersection in the figure in the order vehicle C, vehicle H, vehicle L
yudtcr.why: C has L on its right and must yield to it, so C cannot go first. The correct order is L, C, H.

15rpotx.q: At the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle E goes after vehicle A and vehicle B goes after vehicle E
15rpotx.why: A has no vehicle on its right and goes first; E has A on its right, and B has E on its right. The order is A, E, B.

1jfe8z6.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A does not have to give way to any vehicle
1jfe8z6.why: A has no vehicle on its right, so it does not have to yield to anyone.

lziyk1.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle E has priority over vehicle B
lziyk1.why: E comes from B's right, so it has priority over B.

1dg4f5.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle E goes before vehicle B, but after vehicle A
1dg4f5.why: E yields to A, which comes from its right, and B yields to E. The order is A, E, B.

1yfvenb.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle B must go last
1yfvenb.why: B has E on its right, and E in turn yields to A, so B goes last.

119gxf5.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle B does not have to give way to any vehicle
119gxf5.why: B has E on its right and must yield to it.

1nv05j0.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A must give way to vehicle B
1nv05j0.why: A has no vehicle on its right, so it does not have to yield to B; it goes first.

u9lrxb.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicle B does not have to give way to vehicle E
u9lrxb.why: E comes from B's right, so B must yield to it.

1nsxasw.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicles A and B go at the same time, after vehicle E
1nsxasw.why: A goes first, then E, then B. The order is A, E, B, so A and B do not go together.

1ea0qdf.q: At the intersection shown in the figure vehicles A and B go at the same time, before vehicle E
1ea0qdf.why: E goes after A but before B. The correct order is A, E, B.

hhjtcb.q: At the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A goes after vehicle R and vehicle C goes after vehicle A
hhjtcb.why: R has no vehicle on its right; A has R on its right, and C has A on its right. The order is R, A, C.

s57te2.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A goes before vehicle C and after vehicle R
s57te2.why: A yields to R, which comes from its right, and C yields to A. So A goes after R and before C.

1hjby8q.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle R does not have to give way to any vehicle
1hjby8q.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it does not have to yield to anyone.

1vkqo4g.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure the vehicles go in the order: R, A, C
1vkqo4g.why: R has no one on its right, A has R on its right, and C has A on its right. The order is R, A, C.

t6jt4j.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle C does not have to give way to any vehicle
t6jt4j.why: C has A on its right and must yield to it.

z2jdea.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle A goes before vehicle R and after vehicle C
z2jdea.why: A must yield to R, which comes from its right, and C must yield to A. The order is R, A, C.

1qas3aw.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure the vehicles go in the order: R, C, A
1qas3aw.why: C has A on its right and must go after it. The correct order is R, A, C.

8x88jf.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure vehicle R goes last
8x88jf.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first, not last.

1ivnp3t.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle D may enter the intersection shown in the figure after vehicle R has crossed it
1ivnp3t.why: R comes from D's right, so D must wait for it to cross before entering the intersection.

vymcmt.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle B may enter the intersection shown in the figure after all the other vehicles have crossed it
vymcmt.why: B has D on its right, D has R on its right, and R has no one. The order is R, D, B, so B goes last.

10zx5zu.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle R may enter the intersection shown in the figure without giving way to any vehicle
10zx5zu.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it may enter the intersection without yielding to anyone.

ccyfsl.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle B may enter the intersection shown in the figure after vehicles R and D have crossed it
ccyfsl.why: B has D on its right and must wait for it; D in turn waits for R. So B goes after R and D.

1xmm65o.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle B may enter the intersection shown in the figure at the same time as vehicle R and before vehicle D
1xmm65o.why: B has D on its right and D has R on its right. The order is R, D, B, so B cannot go with R or before D.

100lg4x.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle D may enter the intersection shown in the figure before the other vehicles
100lg4x.why: D has R on its right and must yield to it, so it cannot go before the others.

jr873p.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle R may enter the intersection shown in the figure after vehicles B and D have crossed it
jr873p.why: R has no vehicle on its right, so it goes first, before D and B.

egmhxz.q: According to the right-of-way rules, vehicle B may enter the intersection shown in the figure before the other vehicles
egmhxz.why: B has D on its right and must yield to it, so it goes last, not first.

4hlcva.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure the vehicles go in the following order: D, P, B, N
4hlcva.why: D, turning right, does not cross N's path and goes first; then P, which had D on its right, then B, and finally N.

1fhprpd.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N must go last
1fhprpd.why: N has B on its right and must yield to it; B yields to P and P yields to D. So N goes last.

ulso5w.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B must go after vehicle P
ulso5w.why: P comes from B's right, so B must yield to it.

1ovsay2.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D goes before all the other vehicles
1ovsay2.why: D, turning right, does not cross the path of N, which is on its right, so it can go first.

qjbhc0.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B goes before vehicle N
qjbhc0.why: N has B on its right and must yield to it, so B goes before N.

14ze7in.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N goes after vehicle B
14ze7in.why: B comes from N's right, so N must go after it.

1nrwgd0.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle P may go before vehicle B
1nrwgd0.why: P comes from B's right, so it has priority and may go before B.

16slzbq.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles go in the following order: D, B, N, P
16slzbq.why: B has P on its right and must wait for it. The correct order is D, P, B, N.

1oi25q.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles go in the following order: P, B, N, D
1oi25q.why: P has D on its right and must wait for it. D goes first and the correct order is D, P, B, N.

pt5xai.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles D and N go at the same time
pt5xai.why: D goes first, while N, which has B on its right, goes last, so they do not go together.

1t7t4m6.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles D and B go at the same time
1t7t4m6.why: D goes first and B third, after P, so they do not go together.

l82z14.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle P goes before vehicle B, but after vehicle N
l82z14.why: N has B on its right and goes last, so P goes before both B and N.

1pwas9f.q: According to the right-of-way rules, at the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles B and D go first, in either order
1pwas9f.why: Only D goes first; B has P on its right and must wait for it, so B cannot go first.

27zesk.q: At the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles go in the following order: D, C, A, H.
27zesk.why: D, turning right, crosses no one's path; C has D on its right, A has C on its right, and H has A on its right. The order is D, C, A, H.

1jvyx6x.q: At the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A has its right side occupied
1jvyx6x.why: C comes from A's right, so A has its right side occupied and must yield to it.

1e9cwr2.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D has right of way over vehicle C.
1e9cwr2.why: C has D on its right, so it waits for D, which turns right without crossing H's path, to go first.

13uv0sv.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D is the first to enter the intersection.
13uv0sv.why: D turns right and does not cross H's path, so it goes first. Then come C (who had D on its right), A and finally H.

1fix7wa.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle H is the last to cross the intersection.
1fix7wa.why: H has A on its right, A has C, and C has D, so the order is D, C, A and H goes last.

w9qxwp.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D must give way to vehicle C.
w9qxwp.why: D turns right and crosses no other path, so it goes first. If anything, C, which has D on its right, must give way.

1oij2up.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle C crosses first.
1oij2up.why: C has D on its right and must wait for D to pass, so C is second, not first.

dp802u.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A crosses the intersection before vehicle C.
dp802u.why: A has C on its right, so A must yield and crosses after C.

13yjam2.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: C, A, H, D.
13yjam2.why: The correct order is D, C, A, H: D, turning right, goes first and not last.

1x9p4iq.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: H, A, C, D.
1x9p4iq.why: The correct order is D, C, A, H, the exact reverse: H has A on its right and goes last.

ryiaqu.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles C and H pass first.
ryiaqu.why: D goes first, C follows and H is last. C and H do not go first together.

tn8omm.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicle L goes first.
tn8omm.why: L has no vehicle on its right, because there is no road there, so it goes first.

1vogeup.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicle D is the last to pass.
1vogeup.why: D has A and C on its right, coming from the road to the south, so it yields to both and goes last.

75z1sp.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicles C and A pass at the same time after vehicle L.
75z1sp.why: C and A both have L on their right. Once L has passed, their paths do not cross and they can go together.

1opzhhl.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicle A has right of way over vehicle D.
1opzhhl.why: D comes from A's left, so it has A on its right and must give way to A.

1vffohw.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A must give way to vehicle L.
1vffohw.why: L arrives from A's right, so A must give way to it.

1ka0i1k.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A may cross the intersection together with vehicle C, after vehicle L has passed.
1ka0i1k.why: After L, A and C can proceed together because their paths do not intersect.

eolpnx.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A has right of way over vehicle D.
eolpnx.why: D has A on its right, so D must give way to A.

19x0mug.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, the fastest vehicle goes first.
19x0mug.why: Speed gives no priority: the order depends on position, here L first, then C and A, and D last.

1yapi12.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicle A goes last.
1yapi12.why: A goes after L, together with C. The last is D, which has A and C on its right.

pebchx.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: C, A, D, L.
pebchx.why: L, with nothing on its right, goes first. C and A follow together and D goes last.

bni7bf.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: C, L, A, D.
bni7bf.why: C has L on its right and cannot go before it. The order is L, then C and A, then D.

16mwx2v.q: When crossing the intersection in the figure, vehicles D and L pass at the same time before vehicle A.
16mwx2v.why: L goes first, A after L, and D last: D never goes before A.

snpo8d.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A must give way to all vehicles.
snpo8d.why: A only has to give way to L, which comes from its right. It has right of way over D.

vofqr5.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A goes last.
vofqr5.why: The last to go is D, which has A and C on its right.

1kql5pd.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: H, D, B, L.
1kql5pd.why: H turns left without crossing the path of L, which is on its right, so it goes first. D, B and finally L follow.

qimp8g.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle H goes first.
qimp8g.why: H's path does not conflict with L's, the vehicle on its right, so H can go first.

1he8mtx.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B goes before vehicle L.
1he8mtx.why: B goes before L: L has B on its right and must yield to it.

1xczjuk.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D must give way to vehicle H.
1xczjuk.why: H arrives from D's right (from the north), so D must give way to it.

3n3m9e.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle L must give way to vehicle B.
3n3m9e.why: B arrives from L's right (from the south), so L must give way.

19czmvs.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle L must go last.
19czmvs.why: L has B on its right, B has D, and D has H, so L closes the sequence H, D, B, L.

1xzmx51.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D goes before vehicle B.
1xzmx51.why: B has D on its right and must wait, so D goes before B.

3yriay.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B must wait for the other three vehicles to pass.
3yriay.why: B only has to give way to D, on its right. It goes before L, so it does not wait for all the others.

mcruh6.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle H must wait for vehicles D and B to pass.
mcruh6.why: H goes first: its path does not conflict with L's, so it does not wait for D and B.

zndruf.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles L and D pass at the same time.
zndruf.why: L goes last and D second, so they do not cross at the same time.

1jaj42p.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the following order: H, D, L, B.
1jaj42p.why: B has priority over L, so the correct order is H, D, B, L.

ht0xve.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B, since it turns left, has no right of way over any vehicle.
ht0xve.why: A left-turning vehicle also follows the right-hand rule: B has priority over L, which has B on its right.

erovlz.q: On reaching the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles L and D have right of way because they do not turn.
erovlz.why: Going straight gives no priority; position decides. L goes last and D has H on its right.

oyrqx1.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N goes after vehicle R.
oyrqx1.why: N has R on its right (from the east), so it must wait for R to pass.

7x9df9.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B goes after vehicle N.
7x9df9.why: B turns left and completes its manoeuvre only after letting N, coming from the opposite direction, pass.

va0au3.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle D goes after vehicle R.
va0au3.why: D has R on its right and must give way to it.

eeu6xi.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle R goes after vehicle B has moved to the centre of the intersection.
eeu6xi.why: B, with nothing on its right, enters first and moves to the centre to turn left. Then R goes.

1quad6x.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles D and N pass at the same time after vehicle R has passed.
1quad6x.why: After R, D and N, which have R on their right, can proceed together because their paths do not conflict.

vbj1t4.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B, when entering the intersection, must stop at its centre.
vbj1t4.why: A vehicle turning left must move to the centre of the intersection and stop there until it can complete the turn.

1h4ydbw.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle B must give way to vehicle N.
1h4ydbw.why: N comes from the opposite direction and goes straight, so B, turning left, must give way to it.

15ll94f.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle B enters the intersection before vehicle R.
15ll94f.why: B has no vehicle on its right, so it enters the intersection first, before R.

ily465.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle B may complete the left-turn manoeuvre after vehicle N has passed.
ily465.why: A left turn is completed after oncoming vehicles, such as N, have passed.

1xgxl0o.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle B, after reaching the centre of the intersection, must wait for vehicle N to pass.
1xgxl0o.why: In the centre of the intersection B waits for oncoming N to pass, then completes the turn.
